title: Non-US TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP)
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-05-07
html:
The Affiliate Partner program is currently available in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, United Kingdom

What is a TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner？

Affiliate partners offer matchmaking services for both sellers and creators and assist sellers in distributing and promoting products through dedicated product campaigns. 📌 Check to add a new service category here. Please choose" Seller and Scalable Creator Match-up" as your service category

What are the benefits of becoming an Affiliate Partner on TikTok Shop？

Efficient Reach and Discovery

  • Efficiently reach a broad spectrum of sellers and products through your campaigns, enabling the discovery of new and popular products.

Flexible Collaboration and Commission Earnings

  • Enjoy a flexible collaboration approach with creators, allowing you to generate exclusive product links and distribute them to various creators. This, in turn, helps you earn commissions based on the sales of all products promoted by creators.

How does the Partner Center support TSP?

✨ Partner Center is a central hub for partners to manage their business operations efficiently. Explore these essential product features designed to streamline your day-to-day activities.
